usedFor: Giftbit sends digital gift card rewards, using “Send Reward” and “Create Direct Link Reward” to deliver them.

bestTemplate.name: “Send Reward” in Giftbit
bestTemplate.why: It creates and sends a gift card from a Giftbit template to a recipient.

watchOut: “Send Reward” reaches someone outside the business, so it waits in Needs you for your approval.
